populations: identical computation for development, conformal-calibration and prospective units
geometry_source: structure and BVSE covariates; no DFT or ML outcome

features.name: li_atomic_fraction
features.normalization: z-score with development-population mean and SD

features.name: mean_atomic_number
features.normalization: z-score with development-population mean and SD

features.name: sd_atomic_number
features.definition: population SD of Z over atoms
features.normalization: z-score with development-population mean and SD

features.name: volume_per_atom_A3
features.normalization: z-score with development-population mean and SD

features.name: li_number_density_per_A3
features.normalization: z-score with development-population mean and SD

features.name: hop_length_A
features.definition: |r_t + o.L - r_s| of h*_3 using its own cell offset o (not minimum image)
features.source_field: BVSE path endpoints of h*_3 (nebBVSE122k edge geometry)
features.normalization: z-score with development-population mean and SD

features.name: em_bvse_eV
features.definition: BVSE barrier of the rate-limiting hop (nebBVSE122k, covariate)
features.source_field: nebBVSE122k em_bvse of h*_3 (the nebDFT2k em_bvse column is not used)
features.normalization: z-score with development-population mean and SD

features.name: family_oxide
features.definition: one-hot of the frozen dominant-anion-count-v1 family
features.normalization: none: one-hot indicator with fixed unit weight (not z-scored)

features.name: family_sulfide
features.definition: one-hot of the frozen dominant-anion-count-v1 family
features.normalization: none: one-hot indicator with fixed unit weight (not z-scored)

features.name: family_halide
features.definition: one-hot of the frozen dominant-anion-count-v1 family
features.normalization: none: one-hot indicator with fixed unit weight (not z-scored)

features.name: family_nitride
features.definition: one-hot of the frozen dominant-anion-count-v1 family
features.normalization: none: one-hot indicator with fixed unit weight (not z-scored)

features.name: family_other
features.definition: one-hot of the frozen dominant-anion-count-v1 family
features.normalization: none: one-hot indicator with fixed unit weight (not z-scored)

standardization: z-score fitted on the development population only
missing: any missing feature makes the unit unsupported (fail closed); never imputed
structure_source: one pristine host structure per material_id from the same source for development, calibration and BVEL13k units (never nebDFT2k vacancy NEB supercells)
distance: mean Euclidean distance to the k=5 nearest development-reference units (continuous features z-scored on the development population; one-hots unscaled)
threshold: tau_d = quantile 0.80 of leave-one-chemical-system-out distances over the development population
